children: Vicor Corp. (VICR) filed a Form 8K - Changes to Articles of Incorporation or Bylaws; Change in Fiscal Year - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 10, 2026.

Effective September 9, 2026, the Board of Directors of Vicor Corporation ("Vicor") amended Vicor's By-laws to clarify provisions relating to the removal of directors in Article II, Section 6 thereof. The foregoing summary is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full text of the amended By-laws, which are attached hereto as Exhibit 3.1 (unmarked version) and Exhibit 3.2 (marked version), and are incorporated by reference herein.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/751978/000119312526387927/d539177d8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/751978/000119312526387927/0001193125-26-387927-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
